title_en: Zone peak cooling and heating loads on design days (sensible / latent split)
title_zh: 分区设计日峰值冷热负荷（显热/潜热分开）
inputs: zone geometry; floor heights; envelope U / SHGC; orientation; internal gains; schedules; design-day conditions; OA rates; infiltration
method_standard: EnergyPlus loads model (design days, not EPW maxima); results.json v2 design_cooling_kW / design_heating_kW per zone
outputs: zone load table kW with time of peak; sensible / latent; design_day_basis record
acceptance: every zone has a value; design-day basis recorded; results.json run_status completed

title_en: Block load, diversity and central plant capacity
title_zh: 全楼 block load、同时性与中央设备容量
inputs: zone loads; orientation diversity; OA treatment load; distribution losses; sizing factor
method_standard: sum of non-coincident zone peaks vs coincident block; sizing factor stated; DA09 or EnergyPlus
outputs: block cooling / heating kW; sizing factor; plant capacity brief
acceptance: block ≤ sum of zone peaks; sizing factor ≤ 1.15 unless justified

title_en: Outdoor-air treatment load (DOAS / OA units)
title_zh: 集中新风处理负荷
inputs: OA rates per space; design outdoor state; supply state; heat recovery effectiveness
method_standard: psychrometric calc at design day; heat recovery credited only with vendor data
outputs: OA unit coil duties kW; heat recovery kW
acceptance: coil duties on equipment schedule; energy recovery assumption tagged ASSUMED until vendor data

title_en: Room-by-room loads for terminal unit selection
title_zh: 逐房间负荷用于末端选型
inputs: zone loads split by room; internal gains per room; glazing per room
method_standard: per-room sensible / latent from the loads model or DA09 room method
outputs: room load schedule; terminal duty per room
acceptance: every conditioned room has a duty and a terminal tag

title_en: Outdoor air rates per space
title_zh: 各空间新风量
inputs: occupancy per space; floor areas; space type
method_standard: AS 1668.2 minimum OA per person / per m² (digest record ids)
outputs: OA schedule per space and per AHU / OA unit
acceptance: every occupied space has an OA rate and a clause reference

title_en: Exhaust rates: toilets, laundry, plant, bin rooms, back-of-house
title_zh: 排风量：卫生间、洗衣、机房、垃圾房、后勤
inputs: room list; fixtures; heat loads; odour sources
method_standard: AS 1668.2 exhaust rates; AS 1668.2 discharge / separation rules
outputs: exhaust schedule; fan duties; discharge points
acceptance: every room needing exhaust listed; discharge separations checked (MECH-SPC-03)

title_en: Kitchen exhaust hood airflow, make-up air, duct velocity, grease treatment
title_zh: 厨房排风罩风量、补风、风管风速、油烟处理
inputs: hood dimensions; appliance duty; hood type; kitchen layout
method_standard: AS 1668.2 Section 3 (hood formulae); duct velocity ≥ 7.5 m/s; access panels; fire rating of duct
outputs: hood schedule; KEF duty; make-up air; duct sizes; grease filtration / ESP selection
acceptance: hood flow per AS 1668.2; velocity within limits; make-up ≥ 80 % of exhaust or justified

title_en: Car park ventilation (CO-controlled) and jet fan / duct system
title_zh: 停车场通风（CO 控制）
inputs: car park area; vehicle movements; usage class; geometry
method_standard: AS 1668.2 Section 4 method; CO sensor control; smoke exhaust interface
outputs: supply / exhaust flow; fan duties; sensor zoning
acceptance: flows per AS 1668.2; fire-mode operation defined in MECH-CTL-02

title_en: Stair and lift-lobby pressurisation: flows, door forces, relief
title_zh: 楼梯与电梯前室加压送风：风量、门力、泄压
inputs: stair geometry; door count and leakage; open-door criteria; shaft leakage
method_standard: AS/NZS 1668.1 pressurisation method; door opening force ≤ 110 N; velocity through open door
outputs: fan duty; relief path; pressure differential; door force check
acceptance: door force ≤ 110 N; velocity criterion met; fan on essential supply (ELEC-SUP-02)
na_condition: building not required to be pressurised (rise in storeys / effective height below trigger) — state clause

title_en: Smoke exhaust / zone smoke control / smoke reservoirs
title_zh: 排烟与分区烟控
inputs: fire compartments; smoke zones; fire size; ceiling height; reservoir geometry
method_standard: AS/NZS 1668.1 zone smoke control; fire engineering inputs where PS
outputs: exhaust flows; make-up; fan duties; reservoir sizing; damper schedule
acceptance: flows and reservoirs sized; fire-mode matrix complete
na_condition: no smoke exhaust required by DtS or PS

title_en: Duct sizing and velocities (equal friction / static regain)
title_zh: 风管尺寸与风速
inputs: airflows per run; route lengths; fittings; ceiling zone depth from ARC-CEIL-01
method_standard: equal friction (1 Pa/m typical) or static regain for high-velocity; velocity limits by space NR
outputs: duct schedule per run: size, velocity, friction; bottom-of-duct RL
acceptance: every run sized; velocities within NR limits; sizes fit the ceiling zone (services-coordination-2d)

title_en: System static pressure and fan total pressure per air system
title_zh: 系统静压与风机全压
inputs: index run; fittings loss coefficients; coil / filter / attenuator drops; terminal pressures
method_standard: sum of index-run losses (SMACNA / ASHRAE coefficients); safety margin stated
outputs: fan total pressure Pa per system; index run identified
acceptance: index run pressure documented; margin ≤ 15 % unless justified

title_en: Fan selection, motor kW, VSD and fan power limit
title_zh: 风机选型、电机功率、变频与风机功率限值
inputs: flow; total pressure; efficiency curves; motor class
method_standard: product-library curves; NCC J6 fan motor power limits; VSD control
outputs: fan schedule with duty point, efficiency, motor kW, SFP
acceptance: duty within curve; fan power ≤ NCC J6 limit or JV3 route stated

title_en: Diffuser / grille selection: throw, NC, pressure drop
title_zh: 风口选型：射程、噪声、压降
inputs: room airflow; ceiling height; NR target; diffuser library
method_standard: manufacturer throw / NC data; ADPI check for critical rooms
outputs: diffuser schedule per room
acceptance: NC ≤ target; throw suits room; drop ≤ 30 Pa

title_en: Duct pressure class, leakage class and construction
title_zh: 风管压力等级、漏风等级与构造
inputs: system pressures; fire rating needs; kitchen / smoke ducts
method_standard: AS 4254 classes; AS 1530.4 for fire-rated ducts
outputs: duct construction schedule; leakage test requirement
acceptance: every system classed; test plan in commissioning-tests.csv

title_en: Hydronic flow rates and design ΔT (CHW / HHW / CDW)
title_zh: 水系统流量与设计温差
inputs: coil duties; ΔT design values; glycol %
method_standard: Q = ṁ cp ΔT per coil; diversity per riser
outputs: flow schedule per coil, riser and plant
acceptance: every coil has a flow; riser sums checked against plant flow
deliverable_ref: M-600 CHW/HHW schematic (pressure and flow per level)

title_en: Pipe sizing, velocity and pressure drop per circuit
title_zh: 管径、流速与沿程压降
inputs: flows; pipe material; lengths; fittings
method_standard: Darcy–Weisbach / Hazen-Williams; velocity 1.0–2.5 m/s limits; ≤ 300 Pa/m typical
outputs: pipe schedule per run; index circuit pressure drop
acceptance: every run sized; velocities within limits; noise check with ACU-PIP-01

title_en: Pump head, duty point and NPSHa per pumped circuit
title_zh: 泵扬程、工作点与 NPSHa
inputs: index circuit drop; static head; equipment drops; control valve authority
method_standard: system curve vs library pump curve; NPSHa vs NPSHr
outputs: pump schedule: flow, head, efficiency, motor kW, VSD minimum speed
acceptance: duty within efficiency island; NPSHa ≥ NPSHr + 0.5 m

title_en: System volume, expansion, pressurisation vessel, make-up and water treatment
title_zh: 系统容积、膨胀、定压罐、补水与水处理
inputs: pipe volumes; equipment volumes; temperature range; static height; relief settings
method_standard: expansion volume from temperature range; vessel acceptance factor; fill / relief pressures
outputs: vessel size; fill pressure; relief valve; make-up rate; treatment spec
acceptance: vessel acceptance ≥ expansion volume; relief below component rating

title_en: Thermal expansion of risers, compensation and anchor / guide loads
title_zh: 立管热膨胀、补偿与固定支架荷载
inputs: riser lengths; material; temperature range; anchor positions
method_standard: ΔL = α L ΔT; loops / bellows; anchor force from stiffness or bellows thrust
outputs: expansion schedule; anchor loads to STR-LOAD-06
acceptance: every riser > 30 m has compensation and anchor loads issued to structure

title_en: Balancing valves / PICVs, differential-pressure bypass, control valve authority
title_zh: 平衡阀 / PICV、压差旁通与调节阀权度
inputs: flows; branch pressures; valve library
method_standard: valve authority ≥ 0.5; PICV ranges; bypass sizing for minimum flow
outputs: valve schedule per branch
acceptance: every branch has balancing means; minimum chiller flow protected

title_en: Chiller / heat-pump selection at project conditions and part load
title_zh: 冷水机 / 热泵在项目工况下的选型与部分负荷
inputs: block loads; entering conditions; ambient design; refrigerant; efficiency targets
method_standard: vendor selection at project conditions (not nominal); part-load profile; results.json vendor_duty_check
outputs: equipment schedule rows; comparison ΔCAPEX / ΔOPEX / simple annual return
acceptance: capacity at project conditions ≥ block load × sizing factor; vendor_duty_check status complete

title_en: Heat rejection: cooling tower / dry cooler selection, water balance, Legionella control
title_zh: 散热设备选型、水量平衡与军团菌控制
inputs: heat rejection kW; wet-bulb design; cycles of concentration; drift; plume
method_standard: vendor selection at design wet-bulb; water balance (evaporation, drift, blowdown); AS/NZS 3666 regime
outputs: tower schedule; make-up water L/day to HYD-CW-01; treatment and RMP
acceptance: tower capacity at design wet-bulb; water balance in HYD-CW-01; AS/NZS 3666 regime documented

title_en: Heat recovery availability (chiller heat recovery, ASHP allocation, single energy ledger)
title_zh: 可回收热量与热源分配（单一能量账）
inputs: simultaneous cooling / heating / DHW profiles; recovery capacity; priorities
method_standard: hourly ledger of heat sources and sinks; no double counting
outputs: heat-recovery kW available per hour; DHW source allocation (HYD-HW-03)
acceptance: one ledger; no heat counted twice; peak-hour verification condition stated

title_en: Heating plant capacity and backup (boilers / heat pumps / electric)
title_zh: 采暖热源容量与备用
inputs: heating block load; DHW share; recovery share; ambient derate
method_standard: vendor capacity at design ambient (defrost derate); N+1 policy
outputs: heating plant schedule; backup scenario table
acceptance: capacity at design ambient ≥ block heating; backup scenario closed

title_en: Plant-room heat rejection and ventilation
title_zh: 机房散热与通风
inputs: equipment heat losses; room volume; ambient; allowable room temperature
method_standard: heat balance; ventilation flow = Q / (ρ cp ΔT); mechanical cooling if needed
outputs: plant-room ventilation schedule
acceptance: room temperature within equipment limits at design ambient

title_en: Refrigerant safety: charge limits, occupied-space concentration, machinery-room detection and ventilation
title_zh: 制冷剂安全：充注量限值、房间浓度、机房探测与通风
inputs: refrigerant type and class; charge per circuit; smallest room volume served; machinery room volume
method_standard: AS/NZS 5149 series: practical limit per m³; access category; machinery room requirements
outputs: concentration check per room class; detection / ventilation / alarm requirements
acceptance: every circuit below limit or mitigation designed; machinery room compliant

title_en: Redundancy and failure scenarios (N+1, chiller failure backup, power failure)
title_zh: 冗余与故障工况（N+1、主机故障备用、断电）
inputs: plant list; essential loads; brief resilience targets
method_standard: scenario table: capacity available vs required under each failure
outputs: failure scenario table; backup capacity kW
acceptance: every scenario in the brief has a stated outcome

title_en: Duct and pipe insulation thickness (NCC J6 R-values → thickness), vapour barrier and cladding
title_zh: 风管与管道保温厚度（J6 R 值换算）、隔汽层与外护
inputs: fluid temperatures; ambient; R required per NCC J6 tables; material k; pipe OD
method_standard: R = r2 ln(r2/r1)/k inverted to thickness on the cylindrical basis; standard thickness rounding up
outputs: P-PIPES schedule: material, thickness, VB, cladding per system and size
acceptance: every insulated run has a thickness ≥ NCC requirement; condensation check MECH-INS-02

title_en: Condensation risk on ducts / pipes at actual surface temperature and dew point
title_zh: 风管 / 管道表面结露校核
inputs: internal fluid temperature; ambient dry bulb / RH; insulation thickness; velocity
method_standard: surface temperature calc vs dew point with safety margin
outputs: condensation check per system; worst case space
acceptance: surface temperature > dew point + 1 K in every space

title_en: Duct-borne noise, attenuator selection, regenerated noise to NR target
title_zh: 风管噪声、消声器选型与再生噪声
inputs: fan sound power; duct path attenuation; room absorption; NR target
method_standard: octave-band path calc (ASHRAE / CIBSE B4); attenuator insertion loss from library
outputs: attenuator schedule; NR per room
acceptance: NR ≤ target in every room; coordinate ACU-DUCT-01

title_en: Control descriptions, sequences of operation, setpoints and BMS points list
title_zh: 控制说明、运行顺序、设定值与 BMS 点表
inputs: system list; equipment; setpoints; failure modes; metering
method_standard: functional description per system; points list per equipment
outputs: P-LOGIC; P-POINTS; setpoint schedule (ASSUMED until commissioning)
acceptance: every system has a sequence and points; points list totals per controller

title_en: Fire-mode matrix (AHUs, fans, dampers, smoke control, lifts interface)
title_zh: 消防工况矩阵
inputs: fire zones; systems; FIP interface; smoke control design
method_standard: matrix of trigger → action per equipment; aligned with FIRE-CE-01
outputs: fire-mode matrix; damper / fan actions
acceptance: every fan and damper has a fire-mode action; consistent with cause & effect

title_en: Annual HVAC energy: fans, pumps, plant, by end use
title_zh: 全年暖通能耗（风机、泵、主机、按用途）
inputs: loads model; equipment efficiencies; schedules; control strategy
method_standard: EnergyPlus annual run or hourly ledger; results.json annual_kWh
outputs: annual kWh by end use; kWh/m²; input to THM-ENE-01
acceptance: annual energy reported with method; assumptions tagged

title_en: NCC Section J6 DtS checks: fan and pump power, economy cycle, insulation, controls, energy recovery
title_zh: NCC J6 DtS 逐条核对
inputs: fan / pump duties; system sizes; climate zone; control design
method_standard: NCC 2022 J6 clauses via digest record ids
outputs: J6 compliance matrix rows with PASS / FAIL / N/A
acceptance: every applicable J6 clause has a status; JV3 route stated where DtS fails
na_condition: JV3 whole-building route chosen (list which clauses still apply)

title_en: Plant space, maintenance clearances and equipment replacement routes
title_zh: 机房面积、维护净距与设备更换路线
inputs: equipment list with dimensions (S1 estimates; S5 vendor); door sizes; lift sizes; corridors
method_standard: vendor clearance data; replacement path drawn from plant room to street / crane
outputs: MEP space table (S1); clearance check (S6); replacement route sheet
acceptance: every major unit has a replacement route and clearance drawn

title_en: Riser and shaft sizing for ducts, pipes and trays with access
title_zh: 竖井尺寸（含检修空间）
inputs: duct and pipe sizes per level (S3); tray widths; access side
method_standard: riser packing with 100 mm between services and access face; fire-rating and damper access
outputs: riser schedule per shaft: contents, sizes, free area
acceptance: riser free area ≥ contents + access; no riser filled beyond 70 % at S3

title_en: Intake / exhaust louvre separations and discharge locations
title_zh: 进排风口间距与排放位置
inputs: louvre positions; exhaust types (toilet, kitchen, generator, car park, cooling tower); wind
method_standard: AS 1668.2 separation distances and discharge heights; AS/NZS 3666 cooling tower separations
outputs: louvre schedule with separations; elevation markup
acceptance: every exhaust meets its separation to every intake and opening

title_en: VRF piping length / height limits, refrigerant charge and branch selection
title_zh: VRF 管长 / 高差限值、充注量与分歧管选型
inputs: outdoor / indoor unit positions; pipe routes; vendor limits
method_standard: vendor selection software output retained; charge vs MECH-PLT-06 limits
outputs: VRF piping schedule; charge per system
acceptance: within vendor limits; charge below room limits

title_en: Maximum demand and diversity per board and for the site
title_zh: 最大需量与同时率（各配电盘与全楼）
inputs: connected loads by category; occupancy; equipment schedule; diversity basis
method_standard: AS/NZS 3000 Appendix C method or calculated load model; both shown where they differ
outputs: MD per board kVA / A; site MD; basis table
acceptance: every board has an MD with method; site MD ≤ supply capacity

title_en: Hourly demand envelope and MD limiter / load shedding (where used)
title_zh: 逐时需量包络与限负荷策略
inputs: hourly profiles per load group; shedding priorities
method_standard: hourly ledger summer / winter; shedding sequence; BMS interface
outputs: envelope table; limiter setpoints; shedding order
acceptance: envelope peak consistent with ELEC-MD-01; shed loads listed
na_condition: no MD limit or controlled supply

title_en: Supply authority connection, transformer sizing, loading and transfer arrangement
title_zh: 供电接入、变压器容量、负载率与转供
inputs: site MD; authority rules; substation space; N-1 policy
method_standard: transformer kVA at MD with growth; loading under one-out scenarios
outputs: transformer schedule; substation requirements; transfer logic
acceptance: loading ≤ 100 % normal and stated under N-1; authority requirements listed

title_en: Generator sizing: essential loads, motor starting, step loads, fire pumps
title_zh: 发电机容量：应急负荷、电机启动、分级加载、消防泵
inputs: essential load list; motor starting methods; fire pump duty; fuel autonomy
method_standard: load step table; vendor sizing tool (transient voltage dip ≤ limit); fuel volume for autonomy
outputs: generator schedule; fuel tank; essential load table
acceptance: voltage dip within limit at largest step; fuel autonomy per brief / fire requirement

title_en: UPS requirement and sizing
title_zh: UPS 需求与容量
inputs: critical loads; autonomy; battery type
method_standard: load list; autonomy minutes; battery sizing at end-of-life
outputs: UPS schedule or a documented decision not to provide
acceptance: decision recorded; if provided, autonomy and load list closed

title_en: Power factor at coincident peak and correction
title_zh: 峰值功率因数与补偿
inputs: load types; VSDs; lighting; authority PF requirement
method_standard: weighted PF at peak; capacitor / active filter sizing
outputs: PF check; correction equipment if needed
acceptance: PF ≥ authority requirement at peak

title_en: Harmonic emission assessment and mitigation
title_zh: 谐波发射评估与治理
inputs: non-linear load list; network fault level; authority allocation
method_standard: AS/NZS 61000.3.6 stage 1 / 2 assessment; active filter sizing if needed
outputs: P-HARM report; filter schedule
acceptance: emission ≤ allocated limit at PCC or mitigation designed
na_condition: small installation below assessment threshold (state basis)

title_en: Single-line diagram, essential / non-essential split, life-safety supply arrangement
title_zh: 单线图、应急 / 非应急划分、生命安全供电
inputs: boards; sources; essential loads; fire pump and smoke control rules
method_standard: AS/NZS 3000 and AS 2941 / AS/NZS 1668.1 supply rules; separation of life-safety boards
outputs: SLD; board list; life-safety arrangement note with clause basis
acceptance: every board on the SLD; life-safety loads on compliant supplies

title_en: Equipment full-load currents
title_zh: 设备满载电流
inputs: equipment kW / kVA; PF; efficiency; phases
method_standard: I = P / (√3 V PF η)
outputs: FLC schedule per equipment
acceptance: every motor and heater has an FLC on the schedule

title_en: Protective device rating and type selection
title_zh: 保护电器整定与类型选择
inputs: FLC; starting characteristics; cable ratings; fault levels
method_standard: AS/NZS 3000 coordination Ib ≤ In ≤ Iz; curve type for motors
outputs: breaker schedule per circuit
acceptance: every circuit has device rating ≥ FLC and ≤ cable rating

title_en: Cable current-carrying capacity with derating (grouping, ambient, installation, riser)
title_zh: 电缆载流量与降容（成束、环境、敷设、竖井）
inputs: circuit currents; route conditions; grouping; ambient; installation method
method_standard: AS/NZS 3008.1.1 tables via digest records; derating factors multiplied
outputs: cable schedule: size, type, Iz, derating factors
acceptance: Iz × factors ≥ In for every circuit
deliverable_ref: cable schedule; C-22 / C-46 style write-up

title_en: Voltage drop per segment and total to final circuits
title_zh: 分段与总电压降
inputs: currents; lengths (ELEC-CAB-06); cable impedance; PF
method_standard: AS/NZS 3008.1.1 mV/A·m; total ≤ 5 % (or authority limit) from point of supply
outputs: VD schedule per path
acceptance: total VD ≤ limit at furthest final circuit; segment allocation shown

title_en: Busway rating, tapering, volt drop and joint / tap-off loading
title_zh: 母线槽选型、递减电流压降与插接负荷
inputs: riser loads per level; busway data; lengths
method_standard: tapered current profile; vendor impedance; VD summed per level
outputs: busway schedule; VD profile
acceptance: rating ≥ current at every section; VD within allocation

title_en: Cable and busway lengths from architectural levels and routes
title_zh: 按建筑标高与路由计算电缆与母线长度
inputs: level RLs; route plans; riser positions; slack allowances
method_standard: length = vertical + horizontal + terminations + 10 % slack (stated)
outputs: length schedule; BQ input
acceptance: every cable in the schedule has a length basis

title_en: Earthing conductor sizes, MEN, equipotential bonding schedule
title_zh: 接地线截面、MEN 与等电位连接表
inputs: active conductor sizes; fault currents; disconnection times
method_standard: AS/NZS 3000 earthing tables; adiabatic check where needed
outputs: earthing schedule; bonding list
acceptance: every circuit has a PE size; bonding list complete

title_en: Prospective short-circuit current at every board
title_zh: 各配电盘预期短路电流
inputs: source fault level; transformer impedance; cable impedances; motor contribution
method_standard: IEC 60909 method; three-phase and single-phase to earth; minimum and maximum
outputs: fault level schedule per board
acceptance: every board has Ik max and min; switchgear rating ≥ Ik max (ELEC-SWB-01)

title_en: Earth-fault loop impedance and disconnection times
title_zh: 接地故障回路阻抗与断开时间
inputs: loop impedances; device curves; touch voltage limits
method_standard: AS/NZS 3000 disconnection times; Zs ≤ limit per device
outputs: EFLI schedule per final circuit group
acceptance: every final circuit meets disconnection time

title_en: Protection settings and discrimination (selectivity study)
title_zh: 保护整定与级差（选择性）
inputs: device curves; fault levels; cable damage curves
method_standard: time–current curve overlay; selectivity tables from vendor
outputs: settings schedule; discrimination statement per path
acceptance: full or stated partial selectivity per path; no cable damage curve crossed

title_en: Arc-flash incident energy and PPE categories (preliminary; final at S10 with vendor data)
title_zh: 弧闪能量与个人防护（初步；S10 按厂家数据定稿）
inputs: fault levels; clearing times; working distances; enclosure types
method_standard: AS/NZS 4836 / IEEE 1584 method
outputs: incident energy per board; label basis
acceptance: every main board has an energy value with basis; labels only from final data

title_en: Busbar sizing, short-circuit force and support spacing; switchgear rating vs fault level
title_zh: 母排选型、短路电动力与支撑间距；开关柜额定与故障电流
inputs: rated currents; Ik peak; bar geometry; support type
method_standard: AS/NZS 61439 ratings; electrodynamic force per IEC 60865 method; support spacing
outputs: busbar schedule; rating checks; GA inputs
acceptance: bar temperature rise and force within limits; Icw / Ipk ≥ fault level

title_en: Switchboard losses, temperature rise, ventilation and form of segregation
title_zh: 配电盘损耗、温升、通风与分隔形式
inputs: device losses; busbar losses; enclosure; ambient
method_standard: AS/NZS 61439 temperature-rise method; ventilation flow
outputs: losses W; ventilation requirement; form stated
acceptance: internal temperature within device limits

title_en: Switchroom size, clearances, egress and cable entries
title_zh: 开关房尺寸、净距、疏散与进线
inputs: board sizes (S1 estimate; S6 GA); door swing; escape routes
method_standard: AS/NZS 3000 access and clearance rules; AS/NZS 61439 installation
outputs: switchroom layout check; clearance dimensions
acceptance: clearances and egress compliant; doors open outwards where required

title_en: Floor DB / branch box demand, phase balance and floors-per-DB comparison
title_zh: 楼层箱 / 分支箱需量、三相平衡与每箱带层数比选
inputs: rooms per DB; room loads; diversity
method_standard: demand per DB; phase balance ≤ 10 % imbalance; option comparison with decision record
outputs: DB schedule; phase balance table
acceptance: imbalance ≤ 10 %; comparison recorded

title_en: Guest room / apartment supply allowance under conservative appliance scenarios
title_zh: 客房 / 公寓供电容量（保守用电情景）
inputs: room appliance list; simultaneity; heating / cooling type
method_standard: scenario table; conservative allowance per room
outputs: room load centre schedule
acceptance: room breaker and cable ≥ scenario load

title_en: Lift and fire-pump starting checks (starting current, voltage dip, supply capacity)
title_zh: 电梯与消防泵启动校核
inputs: motor data; starting method; supply impedance
method_standard: voltage dip = Istart × Zsource; limit per authority / equipment
outputs: starting check per large motor
acceptance: dip within limit on normal and generator supply

title_en: Illuminance per space and uniformity
title_zh: 各空间照度与均匀度
inputs: space list; tasks; reflectances; luminaire library
method_standard: AS/NZS 1680 series maintained illuminance; Radiance / DIALux calc
outputs: lux schedule per space; calc files
acceptance: every space meets target lux and uniformity

title_en: Lighting power density and controls (NCC J7)
title_zh: 照明功率密度与控制（NCC J7）
inputs: luminaire wattages; areas; control types; adjustment factors
method_standard: NCC J7 illumination power density with control adjustment factors
outputs: J7 table per space; PASS / FAIL
acceptance: every space ≤ allowance after factors

title_en: Emergency lighting and exit signs: spacing, lux, classification
title_zh: 应急照明与出口标志：间距、照度、分类
inputs: egress paths; mounting heights; luminaire classification
method_standard: AS/NZS 2293.1 spacing tables / calc; exit sign viewing distances
outputs: emergency lighting layout schedule
acceptance: every path has ≥ minimum lux; signs visible per distance

title_en: Lightning protection risk assessment, LPS class and SPD scheme
title_zh: 防雷风险评估、防雷等级与 SPD 方案
inputs: building dimensions; location; ground flash density; occupancy; services
method_standard: AS 1768 risk method; LPS class; SPD coordination
outputs: risk assessment; LPS / SPD schedule
acceptance: risk ≤ tolerable or LPS designed

title_en: EV charging provision, load management and NCC J9 requirements
title_zh: 电动车充电预留、负荷管理与 J9 要求
inputs: car park bays; jurisdiction requirement; supply capacity
method_standard: NCC J9 EV provisions; load management share of MD
outputs: EV schedule; load management; MD share
acceptance: provision meets NCC / DA; MD effect included in ELEC-MD-01

title_en: Metering scheme: NCC J9D3, tenancy, Green Star / NABERS requirements
title_zh: 计量方案：J9D3、租户、绿星 / NABERS
inputs: energy-use categories; boards; tenancies; rating targets
method_standard: NCC J9D3 thresholds; rating tool metering rules
outputs: P-METER; meter schedule; points to BMS
acceptance: every energy-use category over threshold metered; rating tool rules met

title_en: Communications backbone, PoE budget, cable lengths, rack heat and power
title_zh: 通信主干、PoE 功率预算、线缆长度、机柜散热与供电
inputs: device counts; AP layout; switch types; rack positions
method_standard: PoE budget per switch; channel length ≤ 90 m; rack heat to MECH-PLT-05
outputs: ICT schedule; rack schedule
acceptance: PoE within budget; lengths within limit; rack cooling closed

title_en: Annual electrical energy estimate by end use
title_zh: 全年电耗估算（按用途）
inputs: MD model; hours; lighting; HVAC (MECH-ENE-01); DHW; vertical transport; kitchen
method_standard: hourly ledger or rating-tool inputs
outputs: kWh by end use; input to THM-ENE-01 and ratings
acceptance: end uses reconcile with metering scheme

title_en: PV and battery sizing, export limits, structural and fire requirements
title_zh: 光伏与储能容量、出口限制、结构与消防要求
inputs: roof area; irradiance; load profile; authority export rules
method_standard: yield model; export limit; AS/NZS 5033 / AS/NZS 5139
outputs: PV schedule; yield; export arrangement
acceptance: yield and limits recorded; roof loads to STR-LOAD-06

title_en: Potable water daily demand and probable simultaneous demand
title_zh: 自来水日用量与同时流量
inputs: fixture schedule; occupancy; cooling tower make-up; irrigation; kitchen
method_standard: AS/NZS 3500.1 loading / fixture units (digest records) with hotel demand data
outputs: daily demand kL/day; peak flow L/s per riser and main
acceptance: every fixture counted; make-up and process water included

title_en: Authority mains pressure / flow, meter sizing, backflow hazard rating and devices
title_zh: 市政供水压力 / 流量、水表、回流防止等级与装置
inputs: authority letter (S0 data pack); demand; hazard sources
method_standard: authority data; AS/NZS 3500.1 backflow hazard ratings; meter sizing by peak flow
outputs: meter size; backflow schedule; supply pressure at boundary
acceptance: authority data on file (not assumed); every cross-connection hazard has a device

title_en: Storage: break tanks, day storage, fire / potable separation, refill rates
title_zh: 储水：中间水箱、日储、消防 / 生活分隔、补水
inputs: demand; supply reliability; authority rules; pump duties
method_standard: storage = demand × hours of autonomy (brief); refill within off-peak; turnover for water quality
outputs: tank schedule; volumes; refill flow
acceptance: turnover ≤ 24 h or treatment; refill within supply capacity
na_condition: direct mains supply throughout (state pressure basis)

title_en: Pressure zoning, PRVs / PHE pressure breaks and the pressure envelope at every level
title_zh: 压力分区、减压阀 / 板换隔压与各层压力包络
inputs: level RLs; supply pressures; fixture pressure window 250–500 kPa
method_standard: static + pump head per zone; PRV settings; envelope table per level
outputs: pressure per level table; PRV schedule; zone diagram
acceptance: every level within 250–500 kPa at fixtures (or stated window); no zone > 8 levels without break

title_en: Booster / transfer pump duties, standby and VSD
title_zh: 增压 / 转输泵工况、备用与变频
inputs: zone flows; heads; NPSH; control mode
method_standard: system curve vs library pump curve; duty / standby / assist
outputs: pump schedule rows; control description
acceptance: duty on curve; standby policy per brief

title_en: Cold-water pipe sizing per riser and branch, velocity and water-hammer control
title_zh: 冷水管径（立管与支管）、流速与水锤
inputs: flows per branch; material; lengths; valve types
method_standard: AS/NZS 3500.1 sizing tables or hydraulic calc; velocity ≤ 3 m/s (2.4 m/s in rooms); arrestors
outputs: pipe schedule per run; arrestor schedule
acceptance: every run sized; velocities within limits

title_en: Cold-water pumping energy
title_zh: 冷水提升能耗
inputs: pump duties; hours; efficiencies
method_standard: kWh = flow × head × hours / efficiency
outputs: annual kWh; kWh/kL
acceptance: reported; input to THM-WAT-01 / ELEC-ENE-01

title_en: DHW daily energy, peak hour, heating-priority window and simultaneous flow
title_zh: 生活热水日耗能、高峰小时与同时流量
inputs: occupancy; per-key demand; temperatures; profile shares; loop losses
method_standard: energy ledger from demand profile; equivalent-volume reference; fixture coincidence for flow
outputs: daily kWh; peak-hour kWh; peak flow L/s; profile table
acceptance: profile and occupancy stated; loop losses included

title_en: DHW usable storage, recovery and chronological energy balance
title_zh: 热水有效储热、回热与逐时能量平衡
inputs: daily profile; storage temperatures; plant capacity; recovery availability (MECH-PLT-03)
method_standard: hour-by-hour balance; usable storage fraction; peak verification condition
outputs: storage volume; plant kW; balance table
acceptance: no negative balance in the stress case; storage counted once

title_en: Heat source selection: heat pump / heat recovery / immersion backup and annual source energy
title_zh: 热水热源选型：热泵 / 余热 / 电加热备用与年度能量
inputs: energy ledger; vendor capacities at conditions; backup policy
method_standard: vendor data at project conditions; backup covers peak without recovery; annual ledger
outputs: heat-source schedule; annual kWh by source; backup duty
acceptance: backup + storage cover the stress case; annual ledger closes

title_en: Return loop balancing, return pumps, temperatures at furthest point and TMV / zoning
title_zh: 回水平衡、回水泵、末端温度与混水阀 / 分区
inputs: loop lengths; insulation losses; storage temperature; TMV zones
method_standard: heat loss per loop; return flow for ΔT ≤ 5 K; TMV coverage; AS/NZS 3500.4 temperatures
outputs: return pump schedule; balancing schedule; TMV schedule
acceptance: ≥ 60 °C storage; delivery ≤ 45 / 50 °C at fixtures per use; loop ΔT ≤ 5 K

title_en: Legionella control routine and thermal disinfection regime
title_zh: 军团菌控制制度与热消毒
inputs: system layout; dead legs; storage; tower interface
method_standard: AS/NZS 3666 series regime; dead-leg limits; flushing schedule
outputs: risk management plan inputs; control routine; BMS points
acceptance: regime documented; dead legs within limits

title_en: Heated-water pipe insulation and heat loss
title_zh: 热水管保温与热损失
inputs: pipe sizes; lengths; ambient; NCC J8 requirements
method_standard: NCC J8 (heated water services) insulation; loss W/m
outputs: insulation schedule; loop loss kW to HYD-HW-01
acceptance: every heated pipe insulated per NCC; losses consistent with the energy ledger

title_en: Sanitary drainage stacks and branches by fixture units
title_zh: 污废水立管与支管（按当量）
inputs: fixture schedule per level; stack routes; offsets
method_standard: AS/NZS 3500.2 fixture units and stack sizing tables (digest records)
outputs: stack schedule: DN per stack, FU load, room allocation
acceptance: every stack within table capacity; offsets and diversions checked

title_en: Venting: stack vents, relief / cross vents, AAVs, offsets
title_zh: 通气：立管通气、平衡通气、AAV、偏置
inputs: stack heights; branch lengths; fixture positions
method_standard: AS/NZS 3500.2 venting rules
outputs: vent schedule; vent sizes
acceptance: every stack and branch vented per rules

title_en: Sewer connection capacity and authority conditions
title_zh: 污水接驳容量与主管部门条件
inputs: peak sewage flow; authority connection point; trade waste
method_standard: authority requirements; connection capacity vs peak
outputs: connection basis; conditions list
acceptance: authority data on file; capacity ≥ peak

title_en: Sump pumps / lift stations: inflow, storage, duty / standby, alarms
title_zh: 集水井 / 提升泵：流入量、储存、双泵与报警
inputs: basement fixtures; seepage; stormwater ingress; discharge head
method_standard: inflow estimate; storage for pump cycle; duty / standby; AS/NZS 3500.2 pumped drainage
outputs: sump schedule; pump duties; alarm points
acceptance: standby pump; storage ≥ one cycle; high-level alarm to BMS

title_en: Trade waste: grease arrestor sizing by covers, cooling pits, authority acceptance
title_zh: 餐饮排污：隔油池按餐位、冷却池、主管部门认可
inputs: kitchen covers; discharge fixtures; authority sizing rules
method_standard: authority trade-waste sizing method (e.g. Sydney Water by covers)
outputs: arrestor size; location and access; pump-out
acceptance: size per authority method; access for pump-out

title_en: Roof drainage: catchment, IFD rainfall, gutters, downpipes, box gutters, sumps and independent overflows
title_zh: 屋面排水：汇水、IFD 降雨、天沟、落水管、箱形天沟、溢流
inputs: roof plan; IFD (S0 data pack); gutter profiles
method_standard: AS/NZS 3500.3 design storm (ARI per element); box gutter overflow independent of primary
outputs: roof drainage schedule; overflow sizing
acceptance: every roof area drained with overflow; independent overflow for towers (HYD-SW-03)

title_en: Site stormwater, OSD and rainwater reuse tank sizing
title_zh: 场地雨水、OSD 蓄洪与雨水回用水箱
inputs: site catchment; council OSD rules; reuse demand; SSDA commitments
method_standard: council method / MUSIC / DRAINS; reuse yield vs demand
outputs: OSD volume; reuse tank size; yield table
acceptance: OSD per council; reuse tank matches commitment and yield

title_en: Independent overflow / secondary stormwater stack for towers and podiums
title_zh: 塔楼 / 裙楼独立溢流立管
inputs: roof drainage; stack routes
method_standard: AS/NZS 3500.3 overflow provisions; separate discharge
outputs: overflow stack schedule
acceptance: overflow independent of primary and discharging safely

title_en: Gas load, pipe sizing, meter and regulators
title_zh: 燃气负荷、管径、燃气表与调压
inputs: appliance MJ/h; lengths; pressure tiers
method_standard: AS/NZS 5601.1 sizing tables; pressure drop limits
outputs: gas schedule; pipe sizes; meter and regulator
acceptance: every appliance served within allowable drop

title_en: Pool and spa plant: turnover, filtration, heating, chemical dosing, balance tank
title_zh: 泳池 / 水疗设备：循环周期、过滤、加热、加药、平衡水箱
inputs: pool volumes; bather loads; water temperatures; health regulations
method_standard: turnover rate per state health guidelines; filter flow; heater duty; balance tank volume
outputs: pool plant schedule; heating duty to MECH / HYD-HW
acceptance: turnover and filtration within guideline; heater duty on equipment schedule

title_en: Irrigation demand and supply (rainwater / potable)
title_zh: 灌溉需水量与供水
inputs: landscape areas; plant types; climate
method_standard: area × application rate; source priority
outputs: irrigation demand; source; controller
acceptance: demand met by reuse or potable with backflow protection

title_en: Sanitary fixture numbers vs occupancy
title_zh: 卫生洁具数量与人数
inputs: occupancy per area; building class
method_standard: NCC F4 (sanitary facilities) tables via digest
outputs: fixture count table per level
acceptance: every area meets minimum counts; accessible fixtures per ARC-DDA-01

title_en: Pipe materials, supports and maximum spacing, expansion and anchors
title_zh: 管材、支架与最大间距、膨胀与固定
inputs: system temperatures and pressures; pipe sizes; material library
method_standard: material selection table (P-MAT); support spacing per material / size (AS/NZS 3500 / manufacturer); expansion loops
outputs: P-MAT; support schedule; anchor loads to STR
acceptance: every system has a material, support type and spacing; anchor loads issued

title_en: Water-filled tank and equipment weights and floor loads to structure
title_zh: 满水设备 / 水箱重量与楼板荷载（交结构）
inputs: tank volumes; equipment operating weights; footprints
method_standard: operating weight = dry + water; pressure over footprint
outputs: P-LOADS schedule to STR
acceptance: every tank and plant item on P-LOADS with position

title_en: Fire strategy basis: class, type of construction, rise in storeys, effective height, compartment sizes, FRLs
title_zh: 消防策略基础：类别、构造类型、层数、有效高度、分区面积、FRL
inputs: brief; massing; areas per level; sprinkler decision
method_standard: NCC Section C (compartmentation, FRLs) via digest records; DtS vs PS list
outputs: fire strategy memo; F-100 strategy plans; DtS / PS table
acceptance: every compartment and element has an FRL; departures listed

title_en: Occupant numbers, exit count and widths, travel distances, stair widths, discharge
title_zh: 人数、出口数量与宽度、疏散距离、楼梯宽度、出口疏散
inputs: areas per use; occupancy factors; layout; stair geometry
method_standard: NCC Section D (via digest); occupant numbers per use; width per occupant; travel distance limits
outputs: egress calc package per level
acceptance: every storey within travel distance and width limits; provisional until layout freeze (S3)

title_en: Sprinkler hazard class, design density, AMAO, head spacing and coverage
title_zh: 喷淋危险等级、设计密度、作用面积、喷头间距与覆盖
inputs: occupancy per area; storage; ceiling heights; obstructions
method_standard: AS 2118.1 hazard classification and design criteria (digest records)
outputs: sprinkler design criteria table per area; head counts
acceptance: every area classified; density and AMAO stated

title_en: Sprinkler hydraulic calculation at most disadvantaged and most favourable areas, pressure zones
title_zh: 喷淋水力计算（最不利与最有利区）、压力分区
inputs: pipe network; heads; pump / tank; pressure zones
method_standard: Hazen-Williams network calc per AS 2118.1; supply curve vs demand
outputs: hydraulic calc report; pump duty input; max / min pressures
acceptance: demand within supply with margin; max pressure below component rating

title_en: Hydrant flows and pressures per level, booster, feed arrangement
title_zh: 消火栓各层流量压力、水泵接合器、供水
inputs: building height; hydrant count; brigade requirements
method_standard: AS 2419.1 flows / pressures (digest); booster and feed arrangement
outputs: hydrant schedule per level; booster schedule
acceptance: every level within pressure window; booster located per brigade

title_en: Hose reel coverage and hydraulics
title_zh: 消防卷盘覆盖与水力
inputs: hose reel positions; coverage radius; supply
method_standard: AS 2441 coverage; AS 2419.1 combined demand where applicable
outputs: hose reel schedule; coverage plan
acceptance: coverage complete; supply adequate with hydrants

title_en: Fire pump duty, suction, driver type, fuel, testing regime and TCO comparison
title_zh: 消防泵工况、吸水、驱动类型、燃油、测试制度与全寿命成本
inputs: sprinkler and hydrant demands; tank level; driver options; testing rules
method_standard: AS 2941 pumpset requirements; NPSH; diesel fuel autonomy; decision record on driver type
outputs: pump duty; driver decision; test regime; local supplier confirmation
acceptance: duty covers max demand at max pressure zone; decision record closed
na_condition: building without fire pumps (mains adequate — state authority letter)

title_en: Fire water storage effective volume, refill and town-main reliability
title_zh: 消防水池有效容积、补水与市政供水可靠性
inputs: demand duration; town main data; tank geometry
method_standard: AS 2304 tank rules; effective capacity above suction; refill contribution
outputs: tank schedule; effective volume; refill
acceptance: effective volume ≥ demand × duration less accepted refill

title_en: Fire-stopping: every penetration mapped to a tested system and size
title_zh: 防火封堵：每个穿越对应测试系统与尺寸
inputs: penetration schedule (STR-PEN-01); wall / floor types; service types
method_standard: AS 4072.1 / AS 1530.4 tested systems from the details library
outputs: fire-stopping schedule; BQ rows per system
acceptance: 100 % of penetrations mapped; no untested combination

title_en: Fire and smoke damper schedule, ratings and access
title_zh: 防火阀与排烟阀表、等级与检修
inputs: duct crossings of fire-rated elements; system types
method_standard: AS 1682 dampers; access panel requirements
outputs: damper schedule with locations and tags
acceptance: every duct crossing a rated element has a damper or a tested alternative

title_en: Detection zoning, detector type and spacing per space, interfaces
title_zh: 探测分区、探测器类型与间距、联动接口
inputs: ceiling heights; space uses; airflow; zone plan
method_standard: AS 1670.1 zoning and spacing rules (digest)
outputs: detection zone plan; detector schedule; FIP loops
acceptance: every space covered; zone sizes within limits

title_en: EWIS / OWS zoning, speaker layout, sound pressure and intelligibility
title_zh: EWIS 分区、扬声器布置、声压与可懂度
inputs: zones; room acoustics; background noise
method_standard: AS 1670.4 sound pressure and STI where required
outputs: EWIS layout; SPL per space; STI where applicable
acceptance: SPL ≥ requirement in every space; STI where applicable

title_en: Emergency lighting and exit signage (with ELEC-LGT-03)
title_zh: 应急照明与出口标志
inputs: egress routes; luminaire data
method_standard: AS/NZS 2293.1
outputs: layout schedule
acceptance: every route compliant

title_en: Cause and effect matrix: detection, EWIS, lifts, access control, BMS, smoke control, doors
title_zh: 联动矩阵：探测、EWIS、电梯、门禁、BMS、烟控、门
inputs: all fire systems; interfaces; sequence
method_standard: matrix per trigger and per output; consistent with MECH-CTL-02
outputs: cause & effect matrix; commissioning tests
acceptance: every output has a trigger; tests in commissioning-tests.csv

title_en: Fire pump, smoke control and lift power supplies, cable WS classification
title_zh: 消防泵、烟控与电梯电源，电缆 WS 分级
inputs: essential loads; routes; fire compartments
method_standard: AS/NZS 3013 cable classification; AS 2941 / AS/NZS 1668.1 supply rules
outputs: WS cable schedule; supply arrangement
acceptance: every life-safety circuit has a compliant supply and cable class

title_en: Performance solutions: PBDB / FEB, executed analyses (ASET / RSET, CFD, FRL equivalence) with convergence and sensitivity
title_zh: 性能化设计：PBDB / FEB、实际运行分析（ASET / RSET、CFD、FRL 等效）含收敛与敏感性
inputs: DtS departures; fire scenarios; geometry; occupant characteristics
method_standard: IFEG / NCC performance requirements; executed models (not input files) with convergence and sensitivity
outputs: PBDB / FEB draft (S3); PS reports with results (S6)
acceptance: every departure has an analysis with results and acceptance criteria; consultation at S9

title_en: Brigade access, booster location, hardstand and hydrant proximity
title_zh: 消防车道、水泵接合器位置、硬地与市政消火栓距离
inputs: site plan; road access; brigade requirements
method_standard: AS 2419.1 booster location rules; brigade access requirements
outputs: site fire access plan; booster position
acceptance: brigade access and booster compliant; street hydrant within distance

title_en: Gaseous suppression or special hazard systems (if any)
title_zh: 气体灭火或特殊危险系统（如有）
inputs: protected rooms; hazards; volumes
method_standard: AS ISO 14520 / relevant standard
outputs: agent quantity; room integrity; venting
acceptance: room integrity and agent quantity closed

title_en: Dead and superimposed dead loads incl. equipment weights schedule
title_zh: 恒载与附加恒载（含设备重量表）
inputs: materials; build-ups; P-LOADS equipment schedule; façade weights
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.1 densities; equipment operating weights
outputs: load table per level and element; P-LOADS cross-check
acceptance: every plant item and build-up in the load table

title_en: Imposed loads per occupancy and reductions
title_zh: 活荷载（按用途）与折减
inputs: occupancy per area; storage; plant; vehicles
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.1 imposed loads (digest); reduction rules
outputs: imposed load table
acceptance: every area has an imposed load with clause

title_en: Wind loads on the structure and on cladding zones (local pressure factors)
title_zh: 结构与围护风荷载（含局部压力系数）
inputs: region; terrain; shielding; topography; building dimensions; importance level
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.2 (or AS 4055 for housing); Kl local factors for edges / corners
outputs: wind pressure tables for structure and cladding zones; input to FAC-WIND-01
acceptance: pressures per zone tabulated with parameters; wind-tunnel need decided (FAC-WIND-02)

title_en: Earthquake actions: hazard, subsoil, importance level, ductility, base shear, drift
title_zh: 地震作用：危险性、场地类别、重要性等级、延性、基底剪力、层间位移
inputs: site hazard factor; subsoil class; structure type; mass
method_standard: AS 1170.4 or NZS 1170.5 (region); modal analysis from STR-ANL-01
outputs: seismic load table; drift check
acceptance: base shear and drift documented; drift within limits
na_condition: region with no seismic design requirement (state clause)

title_en: Snow and ice actions
title_zh: 雪荷载与冰荷载
inputs: site altitude; roof geometry
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.3
outputs: snow load table
acceptance: applied where required

title_en: Other actions: soil / hydrostatic, temperature, shrinkage, creep, construction, crane and lifting, service anchors
title_zh: 其他作用：土压 / 水压、温度、收缩、徐变、施工、吊装、设备固定支架
inputs: geotech; water table; sequence; anchor loads from MECH-HYD-05 / HYD-MAT-01 / FAC-FIX-01
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.0 / 1170.1; geotech report; anchor reactions
outputs: other-actions table; anchor load register
acceptance: every issued anchor / bracket load is in the structural load register

title_en: Load combinations ULS / SLS
title_zh: 荷载组合（承载力 / 正常使用）
inputs: all actions
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.0 combinations
outputs: combination table used by the model
acceptance: combinations listed and applied in STR-ANL-01

title_en: Gravity system, load path, transfer structures, robustness / disproportionate collapse
title_zh: 竖向体系、传力路径、转换结构、整体稳固性
inputs: grid; spans; program; DfMA constraints
method_standard: first-principles load path; NCC B1 / AS/NZS 1170.0 robustness
outputs: structural scheme memo (S1); load path diagram; transfer list
acceptance: every load has a continuous path to foundations; transfers listed with NOT CALCULATED until analysed

title_en: Lateral system: stability, cores / shear walls, torsion, drift limits, P-Δ
title_zh: 抗侧体系：稳定、核心筒 / 剪力墙、扭转、层间位移限值、P-Δ
inputs: wind and seismic actions; core geometry; diaphragms
method_standard: analysis model; drift limits per AS/NZS 1170 / serviceability; P-Δ
outputs: lateral analysis results; drift table
acceptance: drift within limits; torsional irregularity assessed

title_en: Global analysis model with modelling-assumptions sheet (stiffness modifiers, diaphragms, mass, supports)
title_zh: 整体分析模型与建模假定表（刚度折减、楼板、质量、支座）
inputs: geometry from DB; sections; materials; loads; combinations
method_standard: OpenSeesPy / PyNite from the DB; assumptions sheet; modal results
outputs: analysis outputs: forces, displacements, periods; `.e2k` export; assumptions sheet
acceptance: model checks pass; assumptions sheet complete; results traceable to calc IDs

title_en: Dual-solver comparison (.e2k in ETABS by the signing engineer)
title_zh: 双求解器比对（.e2k 在 ETABS 中）
inputs: same model; results from both
method_standard: compare reactions, periods, drifts, key member forces; ≤ 5 % agreement; 1–3 % expected
outputs: comparison table
acceptance: within tolerance or differences explained by modelling choices
na_condition: signing engineer uses OpenSees results directly

title_en: Slabs (RC / PT): flexure, shear, punching shear, long-term deflection, crack control, vibration
title_zh: 楼板（RC / PT）：抗弯、抗剪、冲切、长期挠度、裂缝、振动
inputs: spans; loads; concrete grade; PT layout
method_standard: AS 3600 (NZS 3101); long-term deflection multipliers; punching at columns; footfall check where required
outputs: slab design summary per slab type; reinforcement / tendon schedule
acceptance: every slab type checked; deflection ≤ limits; punching ≥ demand

title_en: Beams and transfer beams: flexure, shear, torsion, deflection, detailing
title_zh: 梁与转换梁：抗弯、抗剪、抗扭、挠度、构造
inputs: forces from STR-ANL-01; sections
method_standard: AS 3600 / AS 4100 (NZS equivalents)
outputs: member table B1…; utilisation; transfer beam special report
acceptance: every beam has utilisation ≤ 1.0; transfers with full report

title_en: Columns and walls: axial-moment interaction, slenderness, confinement, fire
title_zh: 柱与墙：轴力-弯矩相关、长细比、约束、耐火
inputs: forces; sections; effective lengths
method_standard: AS 3600 / AS 4100; interaction diagrams; fire per STR-FIRE-01
outputs: column / wall table; utilisation
acceptance: every column and wall ≤ 1.0 at all levels

title_en: Core and shear walls: in-plane, boundary elements, coupling beams, openings
title_zh: 核心筒与剪力墙：面内、边缘构件、连梁、开洞
inputs: lateral forces; wall geometry; openings from STR-PEN-01
method_standard: AS 3600 wall provisions; coupling beam design
outputs: wall design summary; boundary element schedule
acceptance: utilisation ≤ 1.0; openings reinforced

title_en: Steel members and connections: capacity, stability, connection design, fatigue where relevant
title_zh: 钢构件与连接：承载力、稳定、连接设计、疲劳
inputs: forces; sections; connection types
method_standard: AS 4100 (NZS 3404); connection capacity tables
outputs: steel member table; connection schedule
acceptance: every member and connection ≤ 1.0

title_en: Timber / CLT members, connections and fire char
title_zh: 木 / CLT 构件、连接与炭化耐火
inputs: forces; grades; moisture; fire requirements
method_standard: AS 1720 (NZS 3603); char rate method
outputs: member table; connection schedule; fire check
acceptance: ≤ 1.0 with fire reduction

title_en: Precast / modular (DfMA): lifting, handling, transport, connections, tolerances
title_zh: 预制 / 模块化（DfMA）：吊装、搬运、运输、连接、公差
inputs: element list; crane data; connection types; transport limits
method_standard: AS 3850 precast; dynamic factors; connection design; tolerance schedule
outputs: element schedule with lifting inserts; connection details; tolerance table
acceptance: every element has lifting and connection design; transport envelope checked

title_en: Secondary elements: stairs, balustrade supports, BMU supports, façade bracket reactions, plant plinths
title_zh: 次要构件：楼梯、栏杆支座、BMU 支座、幕墙支座反力、设备基础
inputs: loads from FAC / MECH / VT; geometry
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.1 loads; member design; anchor design AS 5216
outputs: secondary element table; anchor schedule
acceptance: every issued reaction has a designed support

title_en: Foundations from geotech: bearing, settlement, piles (capacity, group, negative skin friction), rafts
title_zh: 基础（依据岩土）：承载、沉降、桩（承载力、群桩、负摩阻）、筏板
inputs: geotech report (people-commissioned); column loads; water table
method_standard: geotech parameters; AS 2159 piling; raft analysis
outputs: foundation schedule; settlement estimate
acceptance: capacity ≥ loads with geotech factors; settlement within limits; NOT CALCULATED until geotech received

title_en: Retaining and basement walls, hydrostatic uplift / flotation, waterproofing pressures
title_zh: 挡土墙与地下室外墙、水浮力、防水压力
inputs: soil parameters; water table; surcharges
method_standard: AS 4678; uplift check with water table; drainage assumptions
outputs: wall design; uplift check
acceptance: uplift factor ≥ required; wall utilisation ≤ 1.0

title_en: Slab on ground and pavements (housing / light structures)
title_zh: 地坪板与路面（住宅 / 轻型结构）
inputs: site class; loads; subgrade
outputs: slab design
acceptance: per standard

title_en: Durability: exposure class, cover, concrete grade, crack width, corrosion protection
title_zh: 耐久性：暴露等级、保护层、混凝土等级、裂缝宽度、防腐
inputs: location (coastal, chloride); element types
method_standard: AS 3600 exposure classes and cover; AS/NZS 2312 steel protection
outputs: durability schedule per element
acceptance: every element has exposure class, cover and grade

title_en: Fire resistance of structural members (FRL per compartment)
title_zh: 结构构件耐火（按分区 FRL）
inputs: FRLs from FIRE-STR-01; sections; cover
method_standard: AS 3600 Section 5 / AS 4100 Section 12 / AS 1720.4
outputs: FRL check per element type
acceptance: every element meets its FRL

title_en: Penetration schedule and reinforcement around openings; PT no-drill zones; beam depth vs duct routes
title_zh: 开洞清单与洞口加强；PT 禁钻区；梁高与风管走向
inputs: services routes (db/services-routes.json); PT layout; beam schedule
method_standard: opening reinforcement rules; PT tendon clearances; coordination with services-coordination-2d
outputs: penetration schedule; no-drill zone plan; reinforcement details
acceptance: every penetration on the schedule with reinforcement or approval; no penetration in a no-drill zone

title_en: Temporary works: propping / back-propping, formwork, crane bases and ties, hoists, edge protection
title_zh: 临时工程：支撑 / 回撑、模板、塔吊基础与附着、施工电梯、临边防护
inputs: construction sequence; crane data; formwork system
method_standard: AS 3610 formwork; crane supplier loads; back-propping analysis
outputs: temporary works register with designer / signer per item
acceptance: every item has a designer and a sign-off route; drafted S6, finalised S10

title_en: Construction sequence / staged analysis: transfer, PT stages, differential axial shortening
title_zh: 施工顺序 / 分阶段分析：转换、预应力分阶段、竖向差异压缩
inputs: sequence; PT stages; column / wall stress
method_standard: staged analysis; shortening estimate with creep / shrinkage
outputs: stage results; shortening table; pre-set values
acceptance: stages checked; shortening within tolerance for façade / services (FAC-MOV-01)

title_en: Serviceability: deflection limits, footfall vibration, movement joints
title_zh: 正常使用：挠度限值、脚步振动、变形缝
inputs: spans; use; joint layout
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.0 Appendix C limits; footfall (SCI / CCIP methods) where required
outputs: serviceability table; joint schedule
acceptance: every span within limits; sensitive floors checked

title_en: Reactions and movements issued to façade and roof (deflection, drift, creep, tolerances)
title_zh: 向幕墙与屋面提供的反力与变形（挠度、层间位移、徐变、公差）
inputs: analysis results; slab edge details
method_standard: summary of edge deflections, drifts, shortening and tolerances per level
outputs: structure-to-façade interface table
acceptance: table issued and referenced by FAC-MOV-01 / FAC-FIX-01

title_en: Design wind pressures on cladding per zone (local pressure factors, internal pressure)
title_zh: 围护结构各区设计风压（局部压力系数、内压）
inputs: STR-LOAD-03 parameters; building geometry; opening scenarios
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.2 cladding pressures with Kl; AS 4055 for housing
outputs: cladding pressure map per elevation and roof zone
acceptance: every elevation and roof zone has a pressure; corners and edges identified

title_en: Wind-tunnel / cladding pressure study decision for tall or complex buildings
title_zh: 风洞 / 围护风压试验决策
inputs: height; shape; surroundings
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.2 applicability limits; decision record
outputs: decision with basis
acceptance: decision recorded; if study needed it is a people task at S3

title_en: Glass thickness and type: wind, human impact, deflection, edge and support conditions
title_zh: 玻璃厚度与类型：风压、人体冲击、挠度、边部与支承
inputs: pressures; pane sizes; support type; safety locations
method_standard: AS 1288 design charts / calc; laminated / toughened selection
outputs: glass schedule per type; utilisation
acceptance: every pane type checked for wind and impact; deflection within limit

title_en: Glazing thermal / solar performance and thermal-stress breakage risk
title_zh: 玻璃热工 / 遮阳性能与热应力破裂风险
inputs: U / SHGC / VLT targets from THM-FAC-01; shading; tinted glass
method_standard: manufacturer data; thermal stress check for tinted / coated glass with partial shading
outputs: glazing performance schedule; thermal stress check
acceptance: values match the thermal model; stress risk assessed

title_en: Curtain wall / window framing: mullion and transom spans, deflection limits, sections, thermal breaks
title_zh: 幕墙 / 窗框：竖梃与横梁跨度、挠度限值、截面、断热
inputs: pressures; spans; glass weights; deflection limits (L/175 etc.)
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.2 loads; aluminium AS/NZS 1664; deflection limits per AS 1288 / manufacturer
outputs: framing schedule; utilisation; section properties
acceptance: every span within deflection and stress limits

title_en: Brackets and anchors: reactions, post-installed anchors, slab-edge conditions, tolerances, thermal movement
title_zh: 支座与锚固：反力、后置锚栓、板边条件、公差、热胀
inputs: framing reactions; slab edge details; concrete grade; edge distances
method_standard: AS 5216 anchors in concrete; bracket capacity; tolerance ±; STR-CLAD-01 movements
outputs: bracket and anchor schedule; reactions to STR-MEM-08
acceptance: every bracket has a capacity ≥ reaction with tolerance; anchors within edge distance rules

title_en: Cladding fixing capacity and fixing spacing: screw / rivet pull-out and pull-over, tributary area × pressure per zone
title_zh: 围护板固定件承载力与固定间距：螺钉 / 铆钉抗拔与抗拉穿，按分区风压 × 受荷面积
inputs: cladding pressures per zone (FAC-WIND-01); fastener tested capacities; substrate; sheet thickness
method_standard: fastener capacity (manufacturer test data / AS/NZS 4600) with capacity factors; spacing = capacity ÷ (pressure × tributary width); edge / corner zones tighter
outputs: fixing schedule per zone: fastener, spacing, edge distance; setting-out
acceptance: spacing per zone computed and drawn; corner and edge zones separately; no generic 'per manufacturer' without numbers

title_en: Metal wall cladding / façade panels: span tables, support spacing, thermal movement, panel flatness, sub-frame
title_zh: 金属外墙板 / 幕墙板：跨度表、支承间距、热胀、平整度、副框
inputs: panel type; spans; pressures; temperature range
method_standard: manufacturer tested span tables at the zone pressure; thermal movement per panel length; sub-frame design
outputs: panel schedule; sub-frame schedule; movement joints
acceptance: spans within tested tables; joints accommodate movement

title_en: Inter-storey drift, slab deflection, creep shortening and thermal movement accommodation; joint sizing
title_zh: 层间位移、板挠度、徐变压缩与热胀的吸收；缝宽
inputs: STR-CLAD-01 table; façade system; joint types
method_standard: movement stack-up per joint; joint size = movement × sealant factor
outputs: movement schedule per joint type
acceptance: every joint sized for combined movement

title_en: Weatherproofing strategy: pressure equalisation, drainage, flashings, sealant joint sizing, test plan (AS 4284)
title_zh: 防水策略：压力平衡、排水、泛水、密封缝尺寸、测试方案（AS 4284）
inputs: system; exposure; joint layout
method_standard: AS 4284 test criteria; sealant movement capability; drainage paths drawn
outputs: weatherproofing report; joint schedule; test plan
acceptance: every joint has a designed path for water; test plan defined

title_en: Combustibility and fire performance of cladding, insulation and attachments; spandrels, cavity barriers, edge seals
title_zh: 围护材料可燃性与防火性能；层间防火、空腔隔断、边缘封堵
inputs: cladding types; type of construction; insulation; attachments
method_standard: NCC Section C (non-combustible requirements, AS 1530.1 / AS 1530.3, AS 5113 where relevant); spandrel / cavity barrier rules
outputs: combustibility route (S1); fire performance schedule (S6)
acceptance: every external wall component has an evidence path (test report or non-combustible)

title_en: Façade acoustic rating vs external noise (with ACU-EXT-01)
title_zh: 幕墙隔声等级与外部噪声
inputs: external levels; internal criteria; glazing options
method_standard: Rw + Ctr required per elevation; glazing / frame data
outputs: façade acoustic schedule
acceptance: every elevation meets internal criteria

title_en: BMU / façade access: loads, davits, restraint anchors, reach, parking
title_zh: BMU / 幕墙维护：荷载、吊臂、安全锚点、覆盖、停放
inputs: façade geometry; cleaning strategy; roof space
method_standard: AS/NZS 1891 / AS 1657; BMU supplier loads to STR-MEM-08
outputs: BMU schedule; anchor schedule; reach diagram
acceptance: 100 % façade reachable; loads issued to structure

title_en: Roof sheeting: profile, span, fixing pattern per pressure zone, cyclonic testing requirements
title_zh: 屋面板：板型、跨度、按风压分区的固定方式、气旋区测试要求
inputs: roof pressures per zone; sheet profile; support spacing; cyclonic region
method_standard: AS 1562.1 with manufacturer tested spans and fixing patterns at zone pressures; low-high-low cyclic testing where required
outputs: roof sheeting schedule; fixing pattern per zone; setting-out
acceptance: every zone within tested capacity; cyclonic tests referenced where applicable

title_en: Purlins, battens and girts: spans, sections, cleats, bridging, fixings
title_zh: 檩条、挂瓦条与墙梁：跨度、截面、连接件、支撑、固定
inputs: roof loads; spans; sections
method_standard: AS/NZS 4600 / AS 4100 / AS 1684 span tables or calc
outputs: purlin schedule; bridging; cleat schedule
acceptance: every purlin span within capacity; uplift connections checked

title_en: Roof drainage: gutters, sumps, overflows, falls and ponding (with HYD-SW-01)
title_zh: 屋面排水：天沟、集水口、溢流、坡度与积水
inputs: roof geometry; IFD; membrane falls
method_standard: AS/NZS 3500.3; minimum falls; ponding check for deflected roofs
outputs: roof drainage plan; overflow schedule
acceptance: every roof area has primary and overflow; falls ≥ minimum after deflection

title_en: Roof and wall insulation, condensation and vapour control (NCC J / F8)
title_zh: 屋面与外墙保温、结露与隔汽控制（NCC J / F8）
inputs: build-ups; climate zone; internal conditions
method_standard: NCC J4 thermal performance; NCC F8 condensation management; THM-COND-01
outputs: build-up schedule with R-values and vapour layers
acceptance: every build-up meets R and condensation requirements

title_en: Roof safety: anchor points, walkways, edge protection, plant platforms, ladders
title_zh: 屋面安全：锚点、走道、临边防护、设备平台、爬梯
inputs: roof plan; plant positions; maintenance tasks
method_standard: AS 1657; AS/NZS 1891.4; anchor loads to STR
outputs: roof safety plan; anchor schedule
acceptance: every maintenance task has a compliant access and fall-protection path

title_en: Roof plant loads, plinths, vibration mounts and penetration flashings
title_zh: 屋面设备荷载、基础、减振与穿越泛水
inputs: P-LOADS; plant positions; vibration isolation (ACU-VIB-01)
method_standard: load transfer to structure; plinth design; flashing details from library
outputs: plinth schedule; penetration schedule with flashing details
acceptance: every roof plant item has a plinth and a flashed penetration detail

title_en: Waterproofing membranes: wet areas, external / podium / planters, falls and drainage, terminations
title_zh: 防水膜：湿区、外部 / 裙楼 / 种植区，坡度、排水、收口
inputs: wet-area extents (ARC-WET-01); podium layouts; planter depths
method_standard: AS 3740 internal wet areas; AS 4654 external above-ground; falls and drainage
outputs: waterproofing plans; membrane schedule; details
acceptance: every wet area and external deck has a membrane, falls and termination detail

title_en: Balustrades and barriers: loads, heights, glass, posts, fixings, openings
title_zh: 栏杆与护栏：荷载、高度、玻璃、立柱、固定、开口
inputs: locations; loads per use; glass types
method_standard: AS/NZS 1170.1 barrier loads; AS 1288 glass; NCC D3 heights and openings
outputs: balustrade schedule; fixings; utilisation
acceptance: every balustrade type checked with fixings

title_en: External doors and windows: AS 2047 ratings, water penetration, air infiltration, operating forces
title_zh: 外门窗：AS 2047 等级、水密、气密、操作力
inputs: pressures; sizes; DDA force limits
method_standard: AS 2047 performance ratings; AS 1428.1 force limits
outputs: door and window schedule with ratings
acceptance: every opening rated for its zone pressure; forces within DDA limits

title_en: Maintenance and replacement strategy: glass replacement, sealant life, cleaning cycle, access
title_zh: 维护与更换策略：换玻璃、密封胶寿命、清洁周期、通道
inputs: system; access design; lifecycle costs
method_standard: lifecycle schedule; TCO input to decision record
outputs: maintenance strategy; replacement method per element
acceptance: every element has a replacement method without demolition

title_en: External noise sources and levels, internal criteria, façade insulation targets
title_zh: 外部噪声源与噪声级、室内指标、幕墙隔声目标
inputs: noise survey (people-commissioned); road / rail / aircraft data; room uses
method_standard: AS/NZS 2107 internal levels; state road / rail noise policies; Rw + Ctr per elevation
outputs: noise criteria table; façade targets per elevation
acceptance: every façade elevation has a target; survey data on file or ASSUMED with expiry

title_en: Partition and floor ratings (Rw + Ctr, Ln,w), flanking control, doors
title_zh: 隔墙与楼板隔声（Rw + Ctr、Ln,w）、侧向传声、门
inputs: room adjacencies; wall / floor build-ups; door types
method_standard: NCC F7 (2022) sound transmission requirements via digest; tested build-ups from library
outputs: acoustic schedule per wall / floor type; flanking details
acceptance: every SOU boundary meets requirements with a tested build-up
deliverable_ref: A-500 wall types; ACU calc book

title_en: Plant noise to boundaries and neighbouring receivers: propagation, barriers, attenuators
title_zh: 设备噪声对边界与邻近受体：传播、隔声屏、消声
inputs: plant sound power (vendor at S5); positions; receiver distances; council / EPA limits
method_standard: point / line source propagation with directivity and barriers; octave bands
outputs: boundary noise table; mitigation schedule
acceptance: every receiver within limit; vendor data replaces ASSUMED at S5

title_en: Plant noise into occupied spaces above / below / beside plant rooms
title_zh: 设备噪声传入相邻占用空间
inputs: plant sound power; separating constructions; room criteria
method_standard: transmission loss of separating elements; structure-borne paths
outputs: internal plant noise table
acceptance: every adjacent room within NR target

title_en: Duct-borne and break-out noise, attenuator schedule, regenerated noise (with MECH-NOISE-01)
title_zh: 风管传声与透声、消声器表、再生噪声
inputs: fan data; duct paths; room absorption
method_standard: octave-band path calc; break-out per duct wall; regenerated noise at fittings
outputs: attenuator schedule; NR per room
acceptance: NR ≤ target

title_en: Vibration isolation: isolator static deflection, transmissibility, inertia bases, flexible connections
title_zh: 减振：减振器静态挠度、传递率、惰性基座、软连接
inputs: equipment speeds and weights; supporting structure stiffness; sensitivity of spaces
method_standard: isolation efficiency from deflection ratio; inertia base mass rules
outputs: isolator schedule per equipment
acceptance: every rotating item has an isolator with stated efficiency

title_en: Pipe and drainage noise: velocity limits, water hammer, stack noise into rooms, lagging
title_zh: 管道与排水噪声：流速限值、水锤、立管噪声、包裹
inputs: pipe routes near rooms; velocities; stack types
method_standard: velocity limits; lagging / boxing details
outputs: pipe noise mitigation schedule
acceptance: stacks near bedrooms treated; velocities within limits

title_en: Reverberation and room acoustics for restaurants, lounges, function rooms
title_zh: 餐厅、酒廊、宴会厅混响与室内声学
inputs: room geometry; finishes; use
method_standard: Sabine / Eyring RT; absorption schedule
outputs: RT per room; absorption schedule to ID
acceptance: RT within target

title_en: Speech intelligibility (STI) for EWIS in reverberant / noisy spaces (with FIRE-EWIS-01)
title_zh: EWIS 可懂度（STI）
inputs: RT; background noise; speaker layout
method_standard: STI estimate per space
outputs: STI table
acceptance: STI ≥ requirement where applicable

title_en: Construction noise and vibration management inputs
title_zh: 施工噪声与振动管理输入
inputs: site; neighbours; hours; equipment
method_standard: state guidelines; predicted levels
outputs: CNVMP inputs
acceptance: inputs issued for the application

title_en: Loads-version thermal model outputs (results.json v2): zones, block, design-day basis, OA, sensible / latent, sizing factors
title_zh: 热模型负荷版输出（results.json v2）：分区、block、设计日依据、新风、显 / 潜热、裕量
inputs: DB geometry; envelope; schedules; weather; design days
method_standard: EnergyPlus loads model; `templates/results.schema.json`
outputs: results.json (run_status completed); report.md conclusions first; model.idf
acceptance: results.json validates against the schema; run_status completed; design_day_basis filled

title_en: Façade option comparison: peak loads, annual energy, ΔCAPEX, ΔOPEX, simple annual return
title_zh: 幕墙方案比选：峰值负荷、年能耗、ΔCAPEX、ΔOPEX、简单年收益率
inputs: option definitions (WWR, glass, shading, insulation); product prices; tariffs
method_standard: loads model per option; decision record per `templates/decision-record.md`
outputs: comparison table; decision record; PD decision at G3
acceptance: every option has all columns; ≥ 15 % rule applied

title_en: Annual energy by end use and rating estimates (NABERS Energy / Green Star inputs)
title_zh: 全年分项能耗与评级估算（NABERS / 绿星输入）
inputs: MECH-ENE-01; ELEC-ENE-01; HYD-HW-03; occupancy
method_standard: annual ledger; rating-tool method
outputs: energy table kWh/m²; rating estimate with method
acceptance: targets in the brief compared with estimates; assumptions tagged

title_en: NCC Section J compliance model (JV3 reference vs proposed) / NZ H1 modelling method
title_zh: NCC Section J 合规模型（JV3 参照 vs 设计）/ NZ H1 建模法
inputs: S7 IFC geometry; envelope; systems; schedules
method_standard: EnergyPlus JV3 reference building comparison or NZ H1 method; retained parameters
outputs: Energy Compliance Report with PASS / FAIL and margin
acceptance: proposed ≤ reference on every required metric; report retained with inputs
na_condition: DtS elemental route chosen and passing (state)

title_en: NatHERS ratings for Class 1 / 2 dwellings (accredited assessor)
title_zh: NatHERS 评级（1 / 2 类住宅，认证评估员）
inputs: dwelling plans; envelope; orientation
method_standard: accredited assessor with certified software; AI prepares the model inputs
outputs: certificates per dwelling
acceptance: every dwelling meets the required stars; certificates on file

title_en: Daylight and glare analysis for lighting controls and rating credits
title_zh: 采光与眩光分析（照明控制与评级得分）
inputs: glazing; room geometry; sensors
method_standard: Radiance / climate-based daylight metrics
outputs: daylight table; control zoning to ELEC-LGT-02
acceptance: daylight zones defined for controls

title_en: Condensation risk assessment of envelope build-ups (NCC F8)
title_zh: 围护构造结露风险评估（NCC F8）
inputs: build-ups; climate zone; internal humidity
method_standard: NCC F8 condensation management; Glaser / hygrothermal check
outputs: condensation check per build-up
acceptance: every build-up passes or is redesigned

title_en: Airtightness targets, detailing and test plan
title_zh: 气密性目标、构造与测试方案
inputs: envelope area; target rating; test standard
method_standard: target air permeability; blower-door test plan
outputs: airtightness plan
acceptance: target and test plan defined; details reference library

title_en: Water balance: consumption by end use, NABERS Water estimate, rainwater reuse yield
title_zh: 水平衡：分项用水、NABERS Water 估算、雨水回用产量
inputs: HYD-CW-01; HYD-SW-02; occupancy; fixtures (WELS)
method_standard: annual water ledger; reuse yield simulation
outputs: water table kL/yr; rating estimate
acceptance: ledger reconciles with HYD demands

title_en: Refrigerant impact and embodied carbon where targeted
title_zh: 制冷剂影响与隐含碳（如有目标）
inputs: refrigerant charges; leakage rates; materials
method_standard: rating-tool method (e.g. Green Star credit method)
outputs: carbon table
acceptance: reported per tool method

title_en: Lift traffic analysis: handling capacity, interval, car count / size / speed
title_zh: 电梯交通分析：运载能力、间隔、台数 / 容量 / 速度
inputs: population per level; peak profile; building height
method_standard: CIBSE Guide D traffic calc script; hotel / residential criteria
outputs: lift schedule; performance table
acceptance: handling capacity and interval within criteria

title_en: Accessible lift cars and controls
title_zh: 无障碍电梯轿厢与操作
inputs: car sizes; controls; DDA requirements
method_standard: AS 1735.12; NCC E3
outputs: accessible lift check
acceptance: every required lift compliant

title_en: Machine room / machine-room-less space, overrun, pit, heat load, power
title_zh: 机房 / 无机房空间、顶层高度、底坑、发热、供电
inputs: lift schedule; vendor data
method_standard: vendor space and heat data; MECH-PLT-05 for heat; ELEC-DB-03 for starting
outputs: shaft / pit / overrun dimensions; heat kW; power kW
acceptance: dimensions in the DB; heat and power passed to MECH / ELEC

title_en: Fire-fighter and evacuation lift requirements, power and controls
title_zh: 消防电梯与疏散电梯要求、电源与控制
inputs: building height; NCC requirements
method_standard: NCC E3 (fire-fighter lifts) via digest; AS 1735; interfaces to FIRE-CE-01
outputs: requirement statement; supply arrangement
acceptance: requirements met or N/A with clause

title_en: Escalators, goods lifts, dock levellers, car lifts where applicable
title_zh: 扶梯、货梯、装卸平台、汽车升降机（如有）
inputs: program; vehicle types; loads
method_standard: vendor data; AS 1735 series
outputs: schedule
acceptance: every item has a duty and space

title_en: Site catchments, IFD rainfall, minor / major system, pit and pipe sizing
title_zh: 场地汇水、IFD 降雨、小 / 大排水系统、检查井与管径
inputs: survey; IFD (S0); site layout; council DCP
method_standard: rational method / DRAINS; ARI per council
outputs: site drainage plan; pit and pipe schedule
acceptance: minor and major systems sized; overland flow path shown

title_en: OSD and water quality treatment (council requirements)
title_zh: OSD 蓄洪与水质处理（市政要求）
inputs: catchment; pre / post flows; council targets
method_standard: council OSD method; MUSIC for quality
outputs: OSD volume and outlet; treatment train
acceptance: targets met per council

title_en: Earthworks, cut / fill balance, batter stability, dewatering
title_zh: 土方、挖填平衡、边坡稳定、降水
inputs: survey; geotech; levels
method_standard: cut / fill volumes; batter angles per geotech; dewatering method
outputs: earthworks plan and volumes
acceptance: volumes and batters recorded; dewatering approvals identified
na_condition: flat site with no bulk earthworks

title_en: Retaining walls (site) — with STR-FND-02 for basement walls
title_zh: 场地挡土墙
inputs: heights; soils; surcharges; drainage
outputs: wall schedule; drainage
acceptance: utilisation ≤ 1.0; drainage designed

title_en: Pavements, driveways, gradients, transitions and drainage
title_zh: 路面、车道、坡度、过渡段与排水
inputs: vehicle loads; subgrade; layout (TRF-SWEPT-01)
method_standard: AS 3727 / Austroads; AS 2890 gradients
outputs: pavement schedule; long-sections
acceptance: gradients and transitions within AS 2890; pavement thickness per subgrade

title_en: Flood level, freeboard and finished floor levels
title_zh: 洪水位、超高与室内地坪标高
inputs: council flood data (S0 data pack); site levels
method_standard: council flood planning level + freeboard
outputs: FFL statement; flood-affected services list
acceptance: FFLs above planning level; flood-affected plant identified (high-risk item)

title_en: Sewer, water, power, gas and comms connection capacity and points (authority)
title_zh: 污水、给水、电力、燃气、通信接驳容量与接入点
inputs: authority applications (people); demands
method_standard: authority responses
outputs: utilities connection table
acceptance: every utility has a confirmed or ASSUMED capacity with expiry gate

title_en: Erosion and sediment control plan inputs
title_zh: 水土保持方案输入
inputs: site; soils; staging
method_standard: state guidelines
outputs: ESCP inputs
acceptance: issued with the application

title_en: Area schedule: GFA, FSR, NLA, efficiency, key count, BOH ratio
title_zh: 面积表：GFA、容积率、可租面积、效率、房间数、后勤比例
inputs: massing; planning controls; program
method_standard: planning definitions (jurisdiction) via digest / DCP
outputs: area schedule per level; feasibility check
acceptance: GFA within FSR; efficiency and BOH within brief targets

title_en: Accessible SOU counts, continuous accessible path, turning spaces, door widths, ramps, lifts, signage
title_zh: 无障碍房数量、连续无障碍路线、回转空间、门宽、坡道、电梯、标识
inputs: room counts; layouts; door schedule; gradients
method_standard: AS 1428.1 / NCC D4 (2022) via digest; real door leaves and hardware
outputs: access report items (DtS / PS); 1:50 checks
acceptance: every route and room checked against installed clear dimensions
deliverable_ref: D-series access sheets; ID compliance report

title_en: Sanitary facility counts vs occupancy (with HYD-FIX-01)
title_zh: 卫生设施数量
inputs: occupancy; class
method_standard: NCC F4
outputs: count table
acceptance: meets minimums

title_en: Finish fire hazard properties (group numbers, CRF) per location
title_zh: 饰面燃烧性能（组别、临界辐射通量）
inputs: finish schedule; locations (exits, corridors, rooms)
method_standard: NCC C (fire hazard properties) via digest; AS 5637 / AS ISO 9239 test reports
outputs: finishes compliance table
acceptance: every finish has a test report meeting its location requirement

title_en: Slip resistance classes per location (wet / dry, ramps, stairs)
title_zh: 防滑等级（干湿、坡道、楼梯）
inputs: finish schedule; locations
method_standard: AS 4586 / HB 198 classes; NCC requirements
outputs: slip class table
acceptance: every floor finish meets its location class

title_en: Wet-area waterproofing extents, falls and drainage points
title_zh: 湿区防水范围、坡度与地漏
