inputs: room layouts; fixtures
method_standard: AS 3740; NCC F1; one floor waste per wet area with charging fixture or trap primer
outputs: waterproofing extents per room; drainage points to HYD-SAN-01
acceptance: every wet area has extents, falls and a floor waste

title_en: Natural light and ventilation areas per habitable room
title_zh: 天然采光与自然通风面积
inputs: room areas; window sizes
method_standard: NCC F6 (light and ventilation) via digest
outputs: compliance table per room type
acceptance: every habitable room compliant or mechanically served (MECH-OA-01)

title_en: Ceiling zone and clear height stack: structure + services + ceiling per corridor / room type
title_zh: 吊顶空间与净高叠加：结构 + 机电 + 吊顶
inputs: beam depths; duct / pipe sizes (largest per zone); ceiling build-up; required clear heights
method_standard: stack-up per zone type; band order structure → fire → duct → pipe → tray; services-coordination-2d rules
outputs: ceiling-zone sections; zone depth table (db/services-routes.json zones)
acceptance: every zone type has a section and a depth budget; no negative margin

title_en: Window-to-wall ratio and envelope area take-off per orientation
title_zh: 窗墙比与围护面积（按朝向）
inputs: elevations; glazing extents
method_standard: area take-off from the DB
outputs: WWR per orientation; envelope areas
acceptance: values feed THM-LOAD-01 and FAC-WIND-01

title_en: Car, motorcycle, bicycle and accessible parking counts; loading and service bays
title_zh: 车位、摩托车位、自行车位、无障碍车位；装卸与服务车位
inputs: program; council DCP; use classes
method_standard: DCP rates via digest; AS/NZS 2890.6 accessible; AS 2890.3 bicycle
outputs: parking schedule
acceptance: counts meet DCP or PS recorded

title_en: Swept paths for design vehicles, ramp grades and transitions, headroom, sight lines
title_zh: 设计车型扫掠路径、坡道坡度与过渡、净高、视距
inputs: design vehicles; layout; ramp geometry
method_standard: AS 2890.1 / 2890.2 templates and limits
outputs: swept path sheets 1:200; ramp long-sections
acceptance: every design vehicle path clear; grades and headroom within limits

title_en: Loading dock: vehicle types, bay sizes, dock equipment, waste vehicle flow, management plan inputs
title_zh: 装卸区：车型、车位尺寸、装卸设备、垃圾车流线、管理方案输入
inputs: deliveries and waste profile; vehicle sizes
method_standard: AS 2890.2; waste contractor vehicle data
outputs: dock layout; equipment schedule; WMP inputs
acceptance: every service vehicle accommodated; waste flow closed

title_en: Traffic generation and access impact inputs
title_zh: 交通生成量与出入口影响输入
inputs: program; road network
method_standard: state guide to traffic generating developments
outputs: traffic inputs for the application
acceptance: issued with the DA package

title_en: Crane selection, radius / capacity, tie loads, base design and lifting studies for modules / pods
title_zh: 塔吊选型、半径 / 起重量、附着荷载、基础设计与模块 / pod 吊装分析
inputs: site plan; heaviest lifts (STR-MEM-07); sequence
method_standard: crane supplier charts; lifting study per element type; loads to STR-TMP-01
outputs: crane plan; lifting study; tie / base loads
acceptance: every module / pod lift within capacity at radius; loads issued

title_en: Installation sequence, staging and site logistics for modules, pods, cassettes and plant
title_zh: 模块、pod、cassette 与设备的安装顺序、分段与场地物流
inputs: program; access; storage; crane plan
method_standard: sequence diagrams; hook time estimates
outputs: sequence sheets; logistics plan 1:500
acceptance: every element has a sequence step and a delivery route

title_en: Seismic design of non-structural parts and components: parts coefficients, anchorage forces, drift compatibility (AU and NZ)
title_zh: 非结构构件与部件抗震设计：部件系数、锚固力、位移协调（澳新）
inputs: site hazard and subsoil (STR-LOAD-04); building period and height; part categories, weights and positions; importance level
method_standard: AS 1170.4 Section 8 (parts and components) in AU; NZS 1170.5 Section 8 in NZ; anchorage per AS 5216 / manufacturer test data
outputs: parts design table: category, seismic force per part, anchorage demand, drift demand at each level; input to the discipline SEIS rows
acceptance: every services and façade part category has a force and drift demand issued to the disciplines; NZ projects never N/A
na_condition: never in NZ; in AU only where AS 1170.4 exempts the building and every part (state clause and importance level)
deliverable_ref: S-500 seismic parts table; MECH/ELEC/HYD/FIRE-SEIS rows

title_en: Seismic restraint of ducts, pipes, equipment: brace types and spacing, anchor loads, flexible connections, clearances at seismic gaps
title_zh: 风管、水管、设备抗震支吊架：支架类型与间距、锚固荷载、软连接、抗震缝处净距
inputs: parts forces (STR-SEIS-01); run sizes and weights per metre; support layout; seismic joint positions; proprietary brace system data
method_standard: NZS 4219 (NZ, seismic performance of engineering systems) with NZS 1170.5; AS 1170.4 Section 8 in AU; proprietary system tested capacities; producer statement (PS1) in NZ
outputs: seismic restraint plan per level (brace positions, types, spacing), anchor load schedule to STR, flexible-connection schedule, restraint details
acceptance: every run above the exemption size and every equipment item has restraint designed with spacing and anchor loads; braces coordinated in 2D (space beside runs) and in the S7 IFC
na_condition: AU building where AS 1170.4 Section 8 does not apply to these parts (state clause); never in NZ
deliverable_ref: M-400 seismic restraint plans and details; coord_check brace envelopes

title_en: Seismic restraint of switchboards, transformers, generators, batteries, trays and busway; cable slack at joints
title_zh: 配电盘、变压器、发电机、电池、桥架与母线槽抗震固定；变形缝处电缆余量
inputs: parts forces; equipment weights and centres of gravity; tray and busway weights; seismic joint positions
method_standard: NZS 4219 / NZS 1170.5 (NZ); AS 1170.4 Section 8 (AU); vendor anchorage data; AS 5216 anchors
outputs: anchorage schedule per equipment; tray / busway restraint plan; joint crossing details
acceptance: every free-standing item anchored with calc; trays and busway restrained; crossings of seismic joints detailed
na_condition: AU building exempt under AS 1170.4 (state clause); never in NZ
deliverable_ref: E-400 seismic restraint details; switchboard GA base fixing

title_en: Seismic restraint of water and drainage pipes, tanks (anchorage, sloshing), pumps and hot-water units; flexible connections
title_zh: 给排水管、水箱（锚固、晃动）、泵与热水器抗震固定；软连接
inputs: parts forces; pipe sizes and filled weights; tank geometry and levels; equipment weights
method_standard: NZS 4219 / NZS 1170.5 (NZ); AS 1170.4 Section 8 (AU); tank standards for sloshing and anchorage; vendor data
outputs: restraint plan per level; tank anchorage calc; flexible connection schedule
acceptance: tanks anchored with sloshing allowance; pipe restraint spacing per system; flexible connections at every equipment and joint crossing
na_condition: AU building exempt under AS 1170.4 (state clause); never in NZ

title_en: Sprinkler and hydrant pipe seismic bracing, flexible couplings, clearance through structure; fire pump and tank anchorage
title_zh: 喷淋与消火栓管抗震支撑、柔性接头、穿越结构净距；消防泵与水池锚固
inputs: parts forces; pipe layout and sizes; penetrations; pump and tank weights
method_standard: NZS 4541 seismic provisions (NZ sprinklers) with NZS 4219; AS 2118.1 seismic requirements where applicable (AU); AS 1170.4 Section 8
outputs: bracing plan, clearance schedule at penetrations, anchorage calcs
acceptance: bracing spacing and clearances per the applicable standard; braces coordinated with other services
na_condition: AU building exempt (state clause); never in NZ
